youtube.title: Did Coca-Cola Really Invent Red Santa? 🎅 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Did Coca-Cola invent the red-suited Santa? Not quite. In 1931 the company hired artist Haddon Sundblom to paint Santa for its Christmas ads, and those plump, rosy paintings ran for decades, so people assume Coke created the look. But artists had already been dressing Santa in red, and Coke's own archivists say so. Full episode on the channel.
